name: work-governance
description: Composable, tool-neutral governance for goals, planning, delegation, Git, validation, long-running project continuity, project truth, archive curation, and reporting.

interface.shortDescription: Composable, tool-neutral governance for Codex work.
interface.longDescription: Work Governance helps Codex discover the real goal, use Plans and SubAgents only when valuable, protect Git and authority boundaries, keep long-running project development recoverable, promote project truth deliberately, curate completed work before archival, validate proportionally, and report work completely. Each policy module remains independent of storage and tool choices.
defaultPrompt: Use $work-governance:work-lifecycle to preserve goal, authority, momentum, and evidence with only the needed modules.
